claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Saquinavir is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent at 2.5 uM; its only plausible antiproliferative effect would be weak cationic amphiphilic lysosomal/off-target stress, not HIV protease inhibition.
